items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Cannonball Adderley hit the scene in 1955. I’m sure you aware of him quite quickly... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, in one way or another.

ctx.x: Cannonball Adderley hit the scene in 1955. I’m sure you aware of him quite quickly. Jackie McLean was a local hero in New York, and a protégé of Charlie Parker. Phil Woods was coming into his own during those years. Were those all people you were touching base with in one way or another?
Yeah, in one way or another.
